# Slack API

Every operation of the Slack API this CLI offers is a command of its own. Read only the group
you need: `slack skill show api-<group>` prints it, as does the file `api/api-<group>.md` beside
this one. Each command lists its usage and flags as `--help` prints them.

Effects: `read` changes nothing; `write` changes the service; `destructive` deletes or overwrites there.
